newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: LITHUANIA - NOON RADIO HEADLINES - JUNE 12.
newsitem.headline: LITHUANIA - NOON RADIO HEADLINES - JUNE 12.

text.p: Here are the main headlines from Lithuania's M-1 plus radio station's noon news report on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Prime Minister Gediminas Vagnorius left for Tallinn to meet his counterparts from Estonia and Latvia. It is expected that they will sign a joint statement expessing the readiness of the three Baltic countries to join the European Union.
- Railway representatives from Germany, Belarus, Russia and Lithuania meet in Vilnius to discuss the opening of a shuttle train route linking Moscow, Minsk, Klaipeda and Mukran.
- Defense Minister Cheslovas Stankevichius leaves for Belgium to participate in the meeting of the defence ministers of NATO member countries and alliance partners.
